# Relish project instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the repository workflow and validation commands.
Read [SPECS.md](../SPECS.md) for requirements, [PLAN.md](../PLAN.md) for next steps,
and [DEVLOG.md](../DEVLOG.md) for progress.

The current product is a Quest cooking assistant with PC-based food perception.
Food moves, deforms, crosses other pieces and is occluded by hands. Unity widgets
exist; Quest-to-PC perception transport and metric measurement are still open.
The earlier remote-mentor/audio/FastAPI architecture is superseded. Do not use its
old file paths, phase ordering or protocols as instructions for this project.
